But: the oracle is unchanged at 1.04329 ETH, BGD says Aave is not affected, the over-mint went to Kelp's fee address (not circulating into Aave), and Aave's rsETH supply is unchanged. The freeze prevents new rsETH exposure. Liquidations can still occur if rsETH oracle drops. There's some tail risk, but the immediate analysis says no impact.

So the risk to this specific position is low-to-elevated. The incident doesn't touch WETH. The venue (Aave V3 Core) itself is functioning; the earlier exploit claim was a false alarm (internal test).
